title: Multiple banner landmarks
user_impact: Screen reader users cannot uniquely identify the page's 'header' region.
technical_impact: More than one element with role="banner" (implicit or explicit).
source: WAI-ARIA 1.2 banner role (no more than one banner per document); axe landmark-no-duplicate-banner
expectation:
Flags a document with more than one rendered banner (document-scoped header or
role="banner"), at the second. A header inside an article or main is no banner;
a second header hidden at the current breakpoint is not rendered. Best practice
without a criterion.
